summary: S12 (data model, persistence, R2 transport). TV and VV transports are structurally different and must stay so (DIV-4): TV writes through an unauthenticated generic worker (/r2/read|write|list|delete|upload|copy over NaProjectPortal/) plus the ProjectVision Flask server; VV writes through a route-per-feature worker (whitecardopedia-editor-api) whose X-Editor-Api-Key only localhost Flask hands out, so VV authoring is localhost-only. The cheapest route to an identical editor is a VV-authored, same-path, same-name transport facade: VVM/80__CloudflareIntegration/Na__CloudflareIntegration__ApiClient__.js (Na__CfApi, TV's 33 export names, 27 used by 16 TV drawing modules + R2AssetUpload) and VVM/03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__LocalProjectMirror__.js (Na__LocalMirror, 8 names), plus GetProjectFolderFromUrl/GetYearFromUrl in VV's ProjectLoader (imported by 12 TV modules). With it, TV's Transport units (SpecData, Statement, SheetImages, Publish), Lockstep, Register, ProjectData 1.6.0, AutoSave 1.5.0, Assets and Persistence port verbatim or with one-constant seams, and TV's name-stubbed tests port. VV needs one worker deploy (project GET, server-side merge-keys with optional R2 drawings guard, a guarded project-files family over six path families, folderId validation, capability list on /api/editor/health) and Flask work (v2.146 guarded save with fingerprint/409/backups/atomic writes, files/<name>, /api/health, JSON 404 for unknown /api/* because the catch-all answers 200 index.html), then per-feature blueprints (/api/valevision/sheet-images|published|statements|user-config). CRITICAL prerequisites found outside the app: the Whitecardopedia sync run by the SketchUp Cloud Sync plugin purges every R2 image under the project prefix whose basename is not a top-level local file (thumbnails and Layout Editor snapshots today; sheet images, published tiers and statement pictures after the port) and uploads the whole local project.json over R2's editor keys; every VV editor save also bumps the GLOBAL build manifest that cache-busts every GLB for every client. VV has no Na__DevSavedKeys equivalent (disk-only localhost load although it calls R2 the SSOT); recommended one SSOT editor-owned key list used by the overlay, the worker guard and the pipeline. Schema is close (drawings block differs only by TV SavedIso vs VV LayoutModeEnabled; CrossSection__SceneData and per-scene lighting identical); repository URLs must be app-root relative in VV (GitHub Pages sub-path). Found a dormant VV bug (ProjectRecord reads the presentation block, not the project root) and TV back-port items (dev-owned lists lack CrossSection__SceneData and LayoutEditor__DrawingRegister; Register Data hard-codes TV file names; R2 unjudged by TV's save guard; TV worker has no auth and dev CORS). 50 findings, 17 work packages, 8 decisions.

findings.title: Sync pipeline purges every subfolder image on R2
findings.detail: The SketchUp Cloud Sync's Whitecardopedia script builds its keep-set from TOP-LEVEL local images only, then lists every key under VaApps/Projects/{yyyy}/{folder}/ without a delimiter and deletes any png/jpg/jpeg/webp whose basename is not in that set. By code reading this removes PresentationMode/Thumbnails/* and LayoutEditor/Snapshots/* on R2 at each full/images sync today, and would remove sheet images, published tiers and statement pictures after the port. The listing is also unpaginated (first 1000 keys). Not verified against R2.
findings.recommendation: Before any new user content is written to R2: purge only keys with no '/' after the project prefix, paginate the listing, add a stub-S3 test proving subfolder images survive. Adam signs off because the plugin runs it on live projects.
findings.evidence: WCP/Tools__DevUtils/AutomationUtil__SyncSingleProject__ToCloudAndWeb__Main__.py:645-680, called :925-926, :958-959; run by Plugins/Na__ValeVisionCloudSync__Modules__/03__Plugin__CoreAppLogic/...ConfigLoader__.rb:66; local 2026/3047__Doous/LayoutEditor/Snapshots holds 18 webp

findings.title: Sync uploads the whole local project.json over R2's editor keys

A local copy behind R2 (failed Flask mirror, another machine) regresses R2's LayoutEditor__DrawingsData, scenes and section bindings - the class TV closed in v2.39.0 with DEV_OWNED_PROJECT_DATA_KEYS. The pipeline also rewrites IMG-slot thumbnails inside PresentationMode__SavedCameraScenes.

With TV's save cadence (structural auto save, Save Sheets, register, spec sync, sheet-image steps, publishing) every client would re-download every GLB of whatever project it opens after each save.

TV detects missing routes by sniffing error text.
findings.recommendation: Validate folderId once in index.js with the rename handler's YYYY/Folder pattern for every /projects/ route; publish version and route names on /api/editor/health and feature-detect from the facade.

Ported fingerprint, files and blueprint GETs would misread the HTML.
findings.recommendation: Register an /api/<path:rest> catch-all returning 404 JSON for GET and POST, ranked above the static route; keep the facade's parsing defensive.

findings.title: Phase-2 mirror failure leaves disk behind R2
findings.detail: VV saves R2 first, then mirrors the whole document to disk; a mirror failure is only a red toast. TV avoids whole-document writes (key merge) and offers Retry Local Sync after an R2-only success.
findings.recommendation: Facade merge-keys (no whole-document base on R2) plus the D-S12-04 overlay; on a local failure keep the pending local keys and offer TV's Retry Local Sync pattern rather than a toast only.

TV Transport units, Lockstep, Register, SheetImages and Publish modules port verbatim or with constant seams, TV's name-stubbed tests port, and it matches TV's own R2AssetUpload/RenderPreset precedent; TV's transport is not copied, so DIV-4 holds. decisions_needed.question: What shape should the new VV worker API take?
decisions_needed.options: (A) one guarded project-files family (read/write/upload/list/copy/delete over six server-side path families) plus merge-keys and a project GET; (B) a route per feature (S07b statements routes, S08 published W1-W3, sheet-image routes)
decisions_needed.recommendation: A: one handler, one deploy, server-side family rules stronger than TV's client-only guards, maps 1:1 to the facade; S08's server-side delete scope and S07b's statement guards become family rules.

decisions_needed.question: Which relative folder names does VV use for new content under VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/, and are the new local binary folders committed?

decisions_needed.question: Should VV's localhost load overlay editor-owned keys from R2 (TV's Na__DevSavedKeys), using one SSOT list?
